limits: Online training-window success averages are not frozen fixed-reset success rates. Policies change within training episodes; final frozen policies have different rollout histories. Mismatch cause not established here.

Uniform fixed512 queries separate value-network changes from differing rollout states. Expert reference has arm.1 control history and is OOD for trained arm1 models. Native10M hand.1 failure reference matches that recipe but becomes old-distribution off-policy at30/50M.
Reward normalization changes across checkpoints; normalized Q values alone are not comparable raw returns. No true-Q calibration or action-ranking ground truth is claimed.
Target metrics use cloned trainingBN in fixed128-row batches and correct terminated bootstrap mask; truncated still bootstraps pre-reset final observations. Not the actual historical replay batches.
Actor gradients use cloned trainingBN on fixed obs+next_obs and inference critic,3 common-seed draws, no Adam/AMP/unit-normalization history. Q/entropy gradient ratio is not a convergence criterion.
Task-lift flags and sustained-lift-near-palm proxy do not establish secure contact or complete manipulation. Drop proxy is a height criterion, not visual inspection.
All checkpoints/metadata read only, no new GPU runs or core/queue edits.
